# Set Up

## Libraries
```{python}
# Libraries
import re
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

import polars as pl

```

## Define File Paths

```{python}
# File paths
DATA_DIR = Path("data/wikipedia_test")

ARTICLES_FILE = DATA_DIR / "articles.jsonl"
CLEANED_FILE = DATA_DIR / "cleaned_articles.parquet"

# Confirm that the raw article file exists
if not ARTICLES_FILE.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Could not find the raw article file: {ARTICLES_FILE.resolve()}"
    )

print(f"Reading articles from: {ARTICLES_FILE.resolve()}")
print(f"Cleaned output will be saved to: {CLEANED_FILE.resolve()}")

```


## Load the raw articles

```{python}
# Load raw article records
articles_df = pl.read_ndjson(ARTICLES_FILE)

# Inspect the dataset
print(f"Articles loaded: {articles_df.height:,}")
print(f"Columns: {articles_df.columns}")

display(articles_df.head(5))


```


## Validate the data

```{python}
# Check required column
if "text" not in articles_df.columns:
    raise ValueError(
        "The raw article file does not contain the expected 'text' column."
    )

# Check for missing article text
missing_text = articles_df.filter(
    pl.col("text").is_null()
).height

print(f"Articles with missing text: {missing_text}")

```


# Cleaning

## Cleaning Function

```{python}
def clean_article_text(text):
    """
    Apply conservative formatting cleanup to one Wikipedia article.
    Remove references and bibliography sections and everything after them.
    """

    if text is None:
        return ""

    # Normalize Unicode characters
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)

    # Standardize whitespace and apostrophes
    text = text.replace("\u00a0", " ")
    text = text.replace("’", "'")

    # Identify headings that indicate the beginning of references
    reference_headings = {
        "references",
        "bibliography",
        "citations",
        "notes and references",
        "notes",
        "sources"
    }

    # Split article into lines
    lines = text.splitlines()

    cleaned_lines = []

    for line in lines:

        # Normalize heading text for comparison
        heading = line.strip().strip("=").strip()
        heading = heading.lower()

        # Stop processing when a reference-related heading is found
        if heading in reference_headings:
            break

        cleaned_lines.append(line)

    # Reassemble article text
    text = "\n".join(cleaned_lines)

    # Remove numeric citation markers, such as [1] or [2, 3]
    text = re.sub(
        r"\[\s*\d+(?:\s*[,;–-]\s*\d+)*\s*\]",
        " ",
        text
    )

    # Remove common editorial markers
    text = re.sub(
        r"\[(?:citation needed|clarification needed|verification needed)\]",
        " ",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE
    )

    # Remove URLs
    text = re.sub(r"https?://\S+", " ", text)

    # Remove residual HTML tags
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)

    # Normalize whitespace while preserving paragraph breaks
    lines = []

    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", line).strip()

        if line:
            lines.append(line)

    text = "\n\n".join(lines)

    return text.strip()

```

## Test the function on one article

```{python}
# Select the first article
example_text = articles_df["text"][0]

# Apply cleaning
example_cleaned_text = clean_article_text(example_text)

print("--- ORIGINAL TEXT ---\n")
print(example_text[:2000])

print("\n--- CLEANED TEXT ---\n")
print(example_cleaned_text[:2000])

print("Original characters:", len(example_text))
print("Cleaned characters:", len(example_cleaned_text))
print(
    "Characters removed:",
    len(example_text) - len(example_cleaned_text)
)

```


## Apply cleaning to all articles

```{python}
# Apply cleaning to every article
cleaned_texts = [
    clean_article_text(text)
    for text in articles_df["text"].to_list()
]

# Add cleaned text to the original dataset
cleaned_articles_df = articles_df.with_columns(
    pl.Series("cleaned_text", cleaned_texts)
)

# Calculate text-length statistics
cleaned_articles_df = cleaned_articles_df.with_columns(
    pl.col("text")
    .str.len_chars()
    .fill_null(0)
    .alias("original_characters"),

    pl.col("cleaned_text")
    .str.len_chars()
    .alias("cleaned_characters")
)

cleaned_articles_df = cleaned_articles_df.with_columns(
    (
        pl.col("original_characters") -
        pl.col("cleaned_characters")
    ).alias("characters_removed")
)

print(f"Articles cleaned: {cleaned_articles_df.height:,}")

```

### Inspect the cleaning results

```{python}
# Create an article cleaning summary
cleaning_summary_df = (
    cleaned_articles_df
    .select([
        "title",
        "page_id",
        "original_characters",
        "cleaned_characters",
        "characters_removed"
    ])
    .sort("characters_removed", descending=True)
)

display(cleaning_summary_df)

```

### Overall impact of cleaning

```{python}
# Calculate overall cleaning statistics
total_original = cleaned_articles_df["original_characters"].sum()
total_cleaned = cleaned_articles_df["cleaned_characters"].sum()
total_removed = total_original - total_cleaned

percentage_removed = (
    (total_removed / total_original) * 100
    if total_original > 0
    else 0
)

print(f"Total original characters: {total_original:,}")
print(f"Total cleaned characters: {total_cleaned:,}")
print(f"Total characters removed: {total_removed:,}")
print(f"Percentage removed: {percentage_removed:.2f}%")

```
